description: This file defines the ActionableReviewSearchFilterParams class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to represent search filter parameters for actionable reviews within the OrangeHRM dashboard plugin. It extends a core FilterParams class and includes properties and methods for filtering reviews by employee number, reviewer employee number, employee inclusion options, and review statuses.

classes.name: ActionableReviewSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class extending FilterParams to encapsulate search filter parameters related to actionable reviews in the HRM system. It includes constants for employee inclusion options and properties for employee identifiers and review statuses, along with their getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the reviewer employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the reviewer employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the current employee inclusion filter setting.

methods.name: getActionableStatuses
methods.description: Returns the list of statuses that are considered actionable.

methods.name: setActionableStatuses
methods.description: Sets the list of statuses that are considered actionable.

methods.name: getSelfReviewStatuses
methods.description: Returns the list of self-review statuses.

methods.name: setSelfReviewStatuses
methods.description: Sets the list of self-review statuses.
